text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Save me, Miracle Senseeey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I walked down the hallway...
I stumbled upon Daitaku Helios pleading for help from KS Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mira-ten, you're roommates with Ojou, right?!
So you've gotta know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When does Ojou look the happiest?!
What do I gotta do to make her truly crack up?!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like you would know better ways than I would, though...
You're so good at making people smile, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...It just doesn't work on Ojou. I realized something recently—she might be totally stuck in her ways?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Like, I can't festival with Ojou, can't vibe with her, my jokes totally flop, and I can't even play the cheeky delinquent!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: But I just can't stop messing with her! Like... I just wanna see her smile so bad~!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...
Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I'm sure your feelings will reach her. As long as you don't put up weird guards, she will open up to you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...For real?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's do this! Helios Heaven Week: Extra Innings! Time for the Ojou Smile Edition~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —So.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I gave it my all—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: AND YET...?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It totally didn't do anything at all?! Her facial muscles are harder than Jordan's acrylic nails~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Helios! I know this might sound totally uncalled for, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wanna brainstorm a strategy together like old times? If the two of us join forces, we might be able to change things, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pal-chiiin!! As expected of my bestie—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Nah. Actually, it's fine. I'll do this on my own!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I can't explain it, but... I think I wanna be the one to make Ojou smile, all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's true. Wow, I was being so insensitive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In that case, let me just say one thing. Why don't you think about Ruby really carefully one more time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You watch her super closely, right? You're panicking right now so you're overlooking it, but... I'm sure you already know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it?! There might've been one time when Ojou smiled—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when arriving at the park...
A bizarre... or rather, totally fluffy scene unfolded before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: 100 Dogs
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...What is the meaning of all these dogs?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ojou, you've got dogs back at your family home, right? When you talked about them, your voice sounded crazy gentle!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So I asked my friends, and look at this! One hundred party doggos! Insane, right?! You're definitely gonna laugh at this, yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Is that all you had to say?
If so, I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Past crying and straight to complete apathy?! Waaaahhh, please just smile, Ojou~~!!

text_block_list.name: 100 Dogs
text_block_list.text:
!!
Woof, wooof!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment Daitaku Helios let out her loud wail, all 100 dogs pounced right on top of her...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gyahhhhhh?! Forget apathy, this is full flouff?! Mmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...!
J-Just now... you smiled...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You look totally like an angel—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Kh. Are you quite finished?
Good day to you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Dang,
that hit me straight in the heart...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Please, feel free to keep playing with them.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ojou just looked at the doggies, right?! You totally do love 'em after all~~!! Wait up, woof wooof!
